604:t_5:12.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$クロノ$$ feared that existence, and tried to stop all of humanity from advancing into a new era... that is, into the future.」

604:t_5:13.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The history of $$クロノ$$... It has advanced in step with humanity's expansion into space.」

604:t_5:14.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「It began in each of the parallel worlds when humanity reached the Moon... when they discovered something there, and that became the trigger.」

604:t_5:15.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「What was there was... a message to Earth's humanity from an unknown party.」

604:t_5:16.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「This is what it said...」

604:t_5:17.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「'Humanity is a species not permitted to evolve'... it said.」

604:t_5:18.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「From that time on, Earth's humanity has had its history, its world, and its very existence managed by an alien intelligent species.」

604:t_5:19.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「In other words, humanity has been kept as livestock.」

604:t_5:20.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...Before the leaders of every nation who learned of the message on the Moon, that being... I will call it the Administrator here... showed off its own tremendous power.」

604:t_5:21.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「But along with it came a guarantee of Earth's humanity's survival, as long as humanity submitted to the Administrator.」

604:t_5:22.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The humans who were entrusted by the Administrator with monitoring humanity's evolution on its behalf... they are $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_5:23.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Everything in history since then has been manipulated by the hand of $$クロノ$$... in other words, the Administrator.」

604:t_5:24.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Following the Administrator's orders, $$クロノ$$ has controlled humanity by a variety of methods.」

604:t_5:25.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The greatest of those measures was overseeing emigration into space, the new environment that makes humanity evolve.」

604:t_5:26.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Since emigration itself was essential to humanity's survival, they restricted the emigrants' freedom, trying to keep humanity from adapting to the new environment.」

604:t_5:27.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Anyone who defied their will, or who advocated humanity's evolution, has been wiped out by their hands.」

604:t_5:28.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「In the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, some of $$クロノ$$'s people who objected to that situation tried to make the facts public and ask for the people's judgment.」

604:t_5:29.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「That plan, carried out in secret, was about to bear fruit as the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter, the foundation of a new era, but...」

604:t_5:30.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「That it was buried in darkness is something you all already know.」

604:t_5:31.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「And so $$クロノ$$'s control of humanity continued in each of the parallel worlds.」

604:t_5:32.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The assassination of $$ジオン・ズム・ダイクン$$ in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, the assassination of the $$ＡＤＷ$$ leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$...」

604:t_5:33.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Even the $$一年戦争$$ in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world was a setup, a pretext to suppress the Spacenoids.」

604:t_5:34.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...But no matter what means $$クロノ$$ uses, humanity is trying to move forward.」

604:t_5:35.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「That is not the superficial evolution of humanity, such as the appearance of $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s.」

604:t_5:36.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Humanity as a whole species is about to enter a new era... by overthrowing the Administrator that obstructs it... the $$サイデリアル$$.」

604:t_5:37.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...How you will act in response to this truth is not for me to say, as someone who already belongs to the past.」

604:t_5:38.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「But now that the era is facing a new phase, humanity must stand against the fundamental calamity.」

604:t_5:39.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Whether to live a limited present as tamed livestock, or to live a future with infinite possibilities, is for you yourselves to decide.」

604:t_5:40.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「All I can do is tell you the truth. It is you yourselves who will create the future from here.」

604:t_6:4.en:
$n
「$$偽りの黒羊$$, $$欲深な金牛$$, $$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$揺れる天秤$$, $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$立ち上がる射手$$, $$知りたがる山羊$$, $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, $$夢見る双魚$$...」

604:t_7:3.en: ～ $$シャイアン基地$$ Underground: Colony Laser Control Room ～

604:t_7:4.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...What a thing to happen... Not only $$ラプラスの箱$$, but even $$クロノ$$'s existence and doctrine are being announced to the whole world...」

604:t_7:5.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There's no need to be afraid.」

604:t_7:7.en:
$$マーサ$$
「So humanity has been managed by the $$サイデリアル$$ for hundreds of years...?」

604:t_7:8.en:
$$マーサ$$
「That means it's no different from now, with most of Earth already subjugated. It makes no difference at this point.」

604:t_7:9.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Bound by your house, bound by blood, bound by power, you have no doubts about this situation at all, I see.」

604:t_7:10.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then what is it that humanity can do?」

604:t_7:12.en:
$$マーサ$$
「How admirable. Then let's place our hopes in $c.」

604:t_7:13.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「No, Aunt. It is all of humanity that will fight.」

604:t_7:15.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I will take my leave here.」

604:t_7:16.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

604:t_7:17.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I will look for a way to fight this world, in my own manner.」

604:t_7:19.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I understand. If I meet Ensign $$リディ$$, I will tell him that you had words of encouragement for him.」

604:t_7:20.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「That will be acceptable to you, won't it?」

604:t_7:22.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then, if you will excuse me.」

604:t_7:25.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Not yet. If we gather the strength of everyone under $$クロノ$$'s influence...」

604:t_7:27.en:
$$ローナン$$
「$$キング$$... It is you, isn't it?」

604:t_7:28.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「That name is meaningless now. The $$サイデリアル$$ will surely abandon $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_7:30.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「The existence of the Administrator... Protecting that secret was $$クロノ$$'s doctrine. We who failed at it have outlived our use.」

604:t_7:31.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then what are we to do!? If we lose the backing of the $$サイデリアル$$...」

604:t_7:32.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「It is not the old who decide what comes next.」

604:t_7:33.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It's their choice... All we can do is accept it, as a father...」

604:t_7:35.en:
$$アクシオン$$
(My son... The world has been set free, just as you wished...)

604:t_7:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「Mister $$アクシオン$$... I hear that $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ is going to make a statement to the entire world.」

604:t_7:38.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「The Empire is moving too... And so the world and the era begin to move, do they...」

604:t_7:42.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

604:t_7:43.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Foolish, feeble humans of Earth.」

604:t_7:44.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Everything the man called $$エルガン・ローディック$$ said just now is true.」

604:t_7:45.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Know that since the time of your forefathers, you have been the property of us, the $$サイデリアル$$.」

604:t_7:46.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「In the end, you are a species that has lived at our will. Both your lives and your deaths are for me, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, to decide.」

604:t_7:47.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Are you frustrated? Are you angry? Then come and hurl that anger at me.」

604:t_7:48.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I am here in $$ラース・バビロン$$. I have no intention of running or hiding.」

604:t_7:49.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I'll be waiting. Stake the future of this planet and challenge me.」

604:t_7:54.en:
$$シモン$$
「Declaring war on the whole world, huh...!」

604:t_7:55.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Or rather, it's aimed at us, I'd say.」
